scope: Selected fresh original publisher/registry checks and source-specific limitations; not full appraisal. Four previous integrity notices independently rechecked and retained.

checks.identity: Same Cochrane review update, DOI 10.1002/14651858.CD001059.pub6; PMID 41330480. Use versioned DOI rather than changing plain-language page.
checks.design: Review of randomized trials; assessed RoB 2 and trustworthiness.
checks.outcome: Preeclampsia RR 0.83 (95% CI 0.67–1.04), 6 RCTs, 15364 women, low certainty.
checks.contradiction: Compare previous review versions and commentary; inclusion changed. Do not infer calcium adequacy irrelevant or change indicated care.
checks.funding: Review and contributing trials not newly extracted.
checks.applicability: EV-ART-009; C-NUTR-001; outcome-specific review, not clinical recommendation.

checks.interests: Earlier Cochrane review authorship disclosed; intellectual stake, not proof of bias.
checks.outcome: Challenges eligibility/trustworthiness exclusions; needs independent adjudication and sensitivity analysis.
checks.applicability: EV-ART-009; explain uncertainty, not another efficacy study.

checks.identity: Translated/English pages of Cochrane review CD009951.pub3; PMID 33870484.
checks.design: Randomized and cluster randomized prevention trials.
checks.outcome: Preeclampsia RR 1.85 (95% CI 1.04–3.29), 4 trials/955 women, review-rated high certainty.
checks.funding: Trial and review disclosures not fully extracted.
checks.safety: Preserve pregnancy prevention safety signal; not generalizable to all fermented foods, strains, populations or indications.
checks.applicability: EV-ART-009; C-NUTR-002; no automatic supplementation recommendation.

checks.identity: Distinct reports of same Belarus PROBIT cohort; 31 maternity hospitals, 17046 mother-infant pairs, randomized breastfeeding promotion rather than assigned milk type.
checks.design: Cluster RCT and age-16 follow-up (13557 participants; 79.5%). Attrition, downstream exposure and outcome measurement important.
checks.funding: 2018 report: CIHR MOP-53155 and NIH R01HD050758; institutional support.
checks.interests: 2018 report discloses two NeuroTrax employees; instrument used in outcome assessment. Sponsor role and original trial disclosures need more review.
checks.outcome: Age-16 verbal function difference 1.4 points (95% CI 0.3–2.5); not broad cognitive benefit and not randomized breastfeeding vs formula.
checks.applicability: EV-ART-032; avoid duplicate cohort count and guilt-inducing causal claims.

checks.identity: BEEP trial, PMID 32087126; follow-up/report PMC11261424 is related cohort.
checks.funding: NIHR Health Technology Assessment in trial abstract; full commercial/in-kind and sponsor role pending.
checks.design: High-risk term infants; specified emollients; pragmatic randomized trial; outcome data 1210/1394.
checks.outcome: Eczema at age 2: 139/598 vs 150/612, adjusted RR 0.95 (95% CI 0.78–1.16).
checks.safety: No clear prevention benefit; review adverse events and distinguish treatment of diagnosed eczema.
checks.applicability: EV-ART-052; prevention only; no product efficacy guarantee.

checks.identity: Casablanca pregnancy sunscreen survey; title and setting checked.
checks.design: Observational survey; not randomized prevention trial; later product study requires concurrent comparator assessment.
checks.outcome: Survey reported existing melasma in 37% and sunscreen use in 17% at entry. No causal prevention estimate.
checks.applicability: Skin pigmentation context; historical comparator not independent controlled evidence.

checks.identity: Uganda cross-sectional ethnobotanical survey, 206 respondents, PMID 38886787.
checks.funding: UNESCO and Canada's International Development Research Centre grant 4500476471.
checks.interests: Authors declare no competing interests; declaration not independently certified.
checks.design: Reported practices and beliefs, not treatment efficacy or safety; sampling/recall bias; clinical outcomes not tested.
checks.safety: Do not reproduce protocols for labor induction, hemorrhage or abortion; no delayed emergency care.

checks.identity: 2019 Mother's Milk tea safety RCT DOI 10.1177/0890334418787474.
checks.funding: Original cash/in-kind funding not in checked abstract.
checks.interests: One author affiliated with Traditional Medicinals (product manufacturer); original full financial disclosure and sponsor role pending.
checks.design: 60 healthy fully breastfeeding mothers without insufficiency; double-blind, self-reported symptoms, small sample.
checks.outcome: No attributable adverse effects detected; cannot establish absence of rare harms or milk-supply efficacy.
checks.applicability: Product-specific lactation safety research only; no routine recommendation.

checks.identity: Lydia Beatrice Munns, 2024 University of York PhD thesis.
checks.design: Cross-sectional and longitudinal network analysis, separate systematic review of yoga; do not combine as one trial or infer causality.
checks.funding: Thesis acknowledgments not checked; publication overlap pending.
checks.rights: Repository specifies CC BY-NC 4.0 for thesis; no commercial reuse absent additional permission.
checks.applicability: Perinatal body experience and mental health contextual evidence; no efficacy claim.

checks.identity: Publisher episode 418 and transcript/chapters checked; audio not independently reviewed.
checks.claim: Publisher discusses possible induction effects and uncertainties; original studies not fully traced here.
checks.commercial: Childbirth education publisher; episode-specific sponsorship and revenue unresolved.
checks.safety: No unsupervised induction protocol or guidance to delay clinical care.
checks.applicability: Editorial comparison only; not independent study.

checks.identity: Spanish-language Radio UNAM episode on fourth trimester; producer and original-language summary checked.
checks.claim: Summary covers physiological/psychological change, warning signs, sexual health, autonomy and support networks; no full audio or claim trace.
checks.safety: Postpartum emergency warning information must be separately clinically verified.
checks.applicability: Context; link only, no audio redistribution.
